title: Set up your gym
step0: Start fresh or restore a backup
failed: Could not save this step. Check the details and try again.
unreachable: The storage destination refused the request. Check the endpoint, region, bucket and access keys, which must be able to list, write, read and delete; nothing was saved.
changed: Setup changed in another window. Your progress has been refreshed.
unavailable: Setup is unavailable for this install. Sign in to manage your gym.
sessionFailed: Could not check who is signed in. Check your connection, then try again.
timezoneFallback: We couldn't use your browser's timezone, so this is set to UTC. Please check it, and enter a region such as America/Vancouver if your gym is elsewhere.
ownerRequired: Sign in as the owner to continue setup.
sent: Check your inbox for a sign-in link, then return here to continue setup.
emailUnavailable: The gym's email isn't working right now, so no sign-in link was sent. Check the server's email (SMTP) settings, then try again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
ownerSavedSignInFailed: Your owner account was saved, but signing in didn't finish. Sign in as the owner to continue setup.
packHint: Choose any of the shipped packs, or continue without one. Programs, ranks, and colors stay editable.
websiteHint: Link your existing website to the paths below on this gym's hostname. You can point a subdomain at this install.
smtpHint: Connect your email sending service to deliver sign-in links and gym emails.
dnsHint: Follow your service's SPF and DKIM instructions. Use port 587 with STARTTLS unless it recommends another port.
loginHint: Email-link sign-in becomes available when email is configured. Skipping keeps any existing email settings; without email, use your password.
hostHint: Your sending service's SMTP server, not your gym's own domain. For example, Mailgun uses smtp.mailgun.org and SendGrid uses smtp.sendgrid.net.
portMismatch.tls: Implicit TLS is on, but the port isn't 465. Most services use implicit TLS only on port 465: clear this box for port 587 or 2525.
portMismatch.starttls: Port 465 usually needs implicit TLS. Tick this box, or use port 587 or 2525.
fromHint: The From address, on a domain your sending service has verified. It is usually not your SMTP username (Mailgun's username looks like postmaster@mg.example.org).
smtpFailed: The test email failed. Check your SMTP settings and try again, or skip this step.
smtpFailed.connection: The test email failed: the app couldn't connect to the SMTP server. Check the hostname and port; some hosting providers block ports 25, 465 and 587, so try 2525. Or skip this step.
smtpFailed.tls: The test email failed: the secure connection didn't start, or the server didn't offer a secure connection on this port. Implicit TLS should be on for port 465 and off for ports 587 and 2525; if that is already right, use the port your service lists for secure sending. Or skip this step.
smtpFailed.authentication: The test email failed: the SMTP server refused the username or password, or it won't send mail without a login. Check the username, the password and the SMTP hostname. Or skip this step.
smtpFailed.sender_refused: The test email failed: the SMTP server refused the message. Check that the sender address is on a domain your service has verified and that the test recipient is valid. Or skip this step.
stripeHint: Payment configuration is not set up. Continue with billing paused.
secretAccessKey: S3 secret access key (not the Cloudflare API token value)
restoreHint: Use the original backup private key and storage destination. A successful restore skips setup and keeps billing paused.
restoring: Restoring your verified backup. Keep this page open; billing will stay paused.
restoreFailed: Restore failed. Check the storage details, snapshot ID and private key, then start again.
restoreFailure.credentials_rejected: Restore failed: the storage service rejected the access key ID or secret. Check both, then start again.
restoreFailure.bucket_missing: Restore failed: that bucket doesn't exist at the endpoint. Check the bucket name and the endpoint, then start again.
restoreFailure.snapshot_missing: Restore failed: the snapshot wasn't found. Check the snapshot ID, then start again.
restoreFailure.endpoint_unreachable: Restore failed: the storage endpoint couldn't be reached. Check its address and the server's network, then start again.
restoreFailure.wrong_key: Restore failed: this private key doesn't open the snapshot. Use the private key of the backup key the snapshot was made with.
restoreFailure.invalid_key: Restore failed: that isn't a valid backup private key. Paste the whole key, starting with AGE-SECRET-KEY-1.
restoreFailure.damaged: Restore failed: the snapshot is damaged. Try an earlier snapshot.
restoreFailure.unsupported: Restore failed: this version can't read the snapshot's contents.
restoreFailure.interrupted: The restore stopped before the backup was verified. Start it again.
restoreFailure.not_started: The restore could not start. Start it again.
restoreFailure.other: Restore failed. Check the storage details, snapshot ID and private key, then start again. The server log has the cause.
restoreStaged: A verified restore is staged on the server. It finishes by itself when the app restarts (sudo docker compose up -d). If it doesn't, resume it with the maintenance command in the restore guide.
restoreUnreachable: The server isn't answering. This page keeps checking.
restoreUnreachableStaged: The backup was verified, so the restore carries on by itself when the server is back.
restoreUnreachableVerifying: If the server restarted while the backup was being checked, start the restore again once it's back.
pollFailed: Could not read restore progress. Reload this page to retry.
restored: Backup restored. Sign in to your restored gym. Billing, member emails and member texts remain off until you review Go-live.
setupLink: Open the private setup link printed by the installer. You can reprint it with gym-app setup-link on the server.
backupHint: Snapshots are encrypted before uploading. Only your backup private key can open them.
retention: Backups use an 8 GB budget, keeping 24 hourly, 7 nightly, 4 weekly, and up to 2 pre-upgrade snapshots when capacity permits.
savedKey: I saved my private key somewhere safe
finished: Your gym is ready. Billing and member emails remain paused.
testBody: Your gym can send email through its configured sending service.
seeError: See the message at the top of this step.
googleRejected: Google didn't accept this client ID and secret, so nothing was saved. Copy both again from your OAuth client in Google Cloud, then save.
portHint: Many hosting providers block outgoing email on ports 25, 465 and 587. If the test email times out, use your sending service's alternative port, such as 2525.
emailSent: Test email sent to {address}. Check your inbox (and spam folder), then continue.
backupsOn: Backups are on: the destination passed its check. The first snapshot runs at the start of the next hour, then every hour.
endpointHint: The service's address, such as https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, without the bucket name.
check.email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
check.timezone: Enter an IANA timezone, such as America/Vancouver or Europe/London.
check.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as USD or EUR.
check.url: Enter a full address starting with https://.
check.port: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
check.bucketPath: Use the address without the bucket name.
check.googleValue: Paste the value without spaces (at most 512 characters).
